patterns.description: ROS 2 package directories use the stonefish_<name> snake_case prefix (9/9 observed, verified by package.xml enumeration 2026-08-10). Explicit exception: nav_interfaces — its message types are recorded in real sea-trial bags and rosbag deserialization matches the package-qualified type name, so renaming would break bag decoding (codify 2026-08-22).
Python modules are snake_case (excludes __init__, _-prefixed, and *.launch.py). 53/53, 26/26 observed.
ROS 2 launch files are snake_case ending .launch.py (16/16 observed).
ROS 2 message interface files are PascalCase .msg (part of 23/23 observed across msg+srv).
ROS 2 service interface files are PascalCase .srv (part of 23/23 observed across msg+srv).
Config YAML files are snake_case (24/24 observed); uppercase acronyms (e.g. TAM = Thruster Allocation Matrix) are an allowed exception. PascalCase (e.g. Hybrid.yaml) is still flagged.
Stonefish scenario/world scene files are snake_case .scn (31/31 observed across scenarios + data/worlds).
World .scn files are snake_case (31/31 observed). Note: world_ prefix subpattern (6/31) is a weak observation, NOT enforced.

C++ ROS 2 bridge classes use the ROS2<Name> PascalCase prefix (10/10 in the package's inner stonefish_ros2/ subdir). The 2 snake_case node entrypoints (stonefish_simulator.cpp / stonefish_simulator_nogpu.cpp) live directly under src/ and are deliberately outside this glob — info-only, not enforced.

learned_refs: codify-2026-06-23: specificity recomputed per learning-protocol.md §4 over current rule items (structure 8 + naming 9 = 17, inductive 16 + preset 1 -> 16/17); optimizer/output structure+ignore rules already removed from disk (stonefish_control_utils package deleted), so denominator shrank vs init

codify-2026-06-23: naming cpp_ros2 applies_to fixed (src/stonefish_ros2/{src,include}/* -> src/**/stonefish_ros2/{src,include}/**/ROS2*.{cpp,h}); real package one level deeper at src/stonefish_sim/stonefish_ros2/, ROS2* files in inner stonefish_ros2/ subdir — now matches 10, excludes 2 entrypoints
codify-2026-06-23: naming config yaml regex extended to allow all-uppercase acronyms (TAM.yaml = Thruster Allocation Matrix); PascalCase still flagged

organize-2026-08-10: albc_bridge -> stonefish_albc_bridge renamed (sim repo cefb904); it was the sole src/*/ violator of the stonefish_ prefix, added after the 2026-06-23 codify so it never passed a rule check. Recount by package.xml enumeration: 9/9 compliant. ROS node name kept as 'albc_bridge' -- sibling packages use bare function names for node names (thruster_allocator, path_generator_node), so the package-prefix rule does not apply to the runtime node axis.

codify-2026-08-22: naming package-dir regex extended with explicit exception nav_interfaces (sim repo feat/mjkim-integration adds it for KMU/LIG sea-trial bag decoding; bag-recorded msg type names pin the package name, so the stonefish_ prefix cannot apply). The other package from the same integration was renamed instead (sonar_yolo_ros2 -> stonefish_sonar_yolo, albc precedent).
